build_model_parallel_roberta: build a model parallel RoBERTa model instance using ModelParallelRobertaModel.build_model with args and task
run_forward_pass: run a forward pass through ModelParallelRobertaModel with src_tokens and optional classification head name
register_classification_head: register a new classification head on ModelParallelRobertaModel with a name and number of classes
extract_features: extract features from input tokens using ModelParallelRobertaEncoder.extract_features with optional hidden states
configure_base_architecture: configure the base model parallel RoBERTa architecture with 12 layers and 768 embedding dimensions
